fields.Name: Common: Party Lookup Organizations
fields.UserQuestion: Which organizations match what the user is typing into an organization picker?
fields.Description: Up to 20 organizations whose name, legal name or acronym starts with the typed term, or whose website domain starts with the typed domain. Backs bizapps-party-field.
fields.TechnicalDescription: Grain: one row per Organization, TOP 20 ordered by Name, ID. Base table __mj_BizAppsCommon.Organization, prefix LIKE on indexed Name, LegalName, Acronym and WebsiteDomain; no view, no COUNT. Parameters: Term (required), Domain (optional, lower-cased host without scheme, www. or path). Columns: ID, Name, Detail (Acronym and WebsiteDomain joined by ' · ', whichever are set).
